nav_footer:
StarAstra UI
Engine: Kernel + YARA + ML
status_engine_stopped: Engine stopped — threats are NOT detected
confirm_pause_text:
The antivirus engine will be STOPPED for {min} minutes.
New threats will NOT be detected during this time.

Continue?
confirm_delete_text: The file will be permanently deleted. Continue?
err_engine_not_found_text:
FAILED TO STOP: {how}.
Run sentinel_service.exe or install the SentinelCoreSvc service (Sentinel/service_manager.ps1 -Install).
err_engine_start_failed_text:
Resume failed: {how}.
Protection stays off — start sentinel_service.exe manually.
err_uac_required_text:
The engine is installed as a Windows service (SentinelCoreSvc).
Stopping the service requires administrator rights — run StarAstra as administrator or use service_manager.ps1.
err_engine_not_running_text:
No engine process or service found — detection is already inactive.
StarAstra switches to "Paused" for {min} min.
Press "Resume now" to start the engine earlier.
confirm_close_paused_text: Protection is paused. Restart the engine before exit?
excl_note_engine: No engine-side exclusion mechanism was found (settings.yaml is missing from sentinel_pkg). StarAstra exclusions are a UI-layer feature: they suppress notifications and event highlighting but do not affect engine scanning.
guard_alert_text_added: EXTERNAL exclusion change detected: {n} added. This may be an attempt to weaken protection.
burst_subtitle: In the last 10 seconds: {n} hits. Latest paths shown.
mode_active: Active Remediation — auto-block threats and quarantine
mode_safe: Safe Audit Mode — alerts only, files untouched
settings_autostart: Start StarAstra when I sign in to Windows
settings_autostart_tip: Only the protection engine starts at sign-in; no window is opened. To open the UI, launch StarAstra from the Start menu.
settings_autostart_openwin_tip: If enabled, the StarAstra window opens at sign-in as well (otherwise protection runs in the background).
err_autostart_failed: Could not change autostart (HKCU registry). See data\launcher.log for details.
pause_long_confirm: You are pausing protection for {min} minutes. That is a long time. Continue?
tray_minimized_text:
StarAstra is minimized to the tray, protection is running.
To quit completely, use the tray icon menu.
settings_close_to_tray_tip: When the window is closed, StarAstra keeps protecting the system in the background. To quit completely, use the tray icon menu.
theme_restart_note: Full recoloring is applied after UI restart.
scan_confirm_full_text:
A full scan checks ALL drives and may take several hours.

Start it?
scan_busy_text: Wait for the current scan to finish or cancel it.
scan_runner_missing: starastra_scan.py not found — scanning is unavailable. Please reinstall StarAstra.
scan_cancelled_text:
Files scanned before cancel: {files}.
Detected threats were already handled by the engine.
scan_cancel_confirm_text:
Abort the current scan?
Threats already found remain handled.
scan_failed_text: The scan process exited unexpectedly. See data\engine.log for details.
schedule_enable_tip: Every day at the chosen time a background scan runs without opening the window. The result arrives as a notification and in History.
sched_failed_toast: The background scan failed. See data\engine.log for details.
sched_busy_text: A scheduled background scan is already running. Please wait.
updates_not_configured_text:
The update server is not configured.
The app will announce new versions later.
opt_not_supported: Not supported by the current engine version
overview_unsupported_note: Memory scan and canary traps are disabled: not supported by the current engine version.
behavior_settings_note: Detects Office→Shell chains, LOLBins, PowerShell -enc, scripts from Temp reaching the network. Trusted processes (explorer, browsers — Anti-Freeze Guard whitelist) are never suspended. Changes apply without restart.
behavior_rule_temp_network: Process from Temp/Downloads connected to the network
behavior_rule_script_engine: Windows script engine spawned child processes
